additional_info.body:
Hi Maxime, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I found that the terminal is not communicating properly, the development team is preparing a workaround for this problem.
For now, I can reestablish the communication remotely without rebooting the charger.
Since you have access to SCB, you can check this error:
If you see it, then you can reboot the charger and it will work again.
When we have a fix, someone will convey this message to you. For now, the CCV is working again.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
